pātheyyatthāyā.g: maggaṁ gacchantānaṁ antarāmaggatthāya paṭiyattaṁ yaṁkiñci baddhasattu-abaddhasattutilataṇḍulādi sabbaṁ idha manthotveva saṅkhyaṁ gacchati.

pātheyyatthāya.g: maggaṁ gacchantānaṁ antarāmaggatthāya paṭiyattaṁ yaṁkiñci baddhasattu-abaddhasattutilataṇḍulādi sabbaṁ idha manthotveva saṅkhyaṁ gacchati.

Pātheyyaṁ.g: ettha sace keci sayameva ñatvā denti, iccetaṁ kusalaṁ.
gamikassa taṇḍulādipātheyyaṁ viya paralokaṁ gacchantassa tava kusalapātheyyampi natthīti attho.
idaṁ kiñcāpi heṭṭhā vuttameva, upāsakassa pana punappunaṁ daḷhīkaraṇatthaṁ idhāpi Satthārā kathitaṁ.

pātheyyaṁ.g: saddhaṁ uppādetvā dānaṁ deti, sīlaṁ rakkhati, uposathakammaṁ karoti, tenetaṁ vuttaṁ.
saddhā nāma sattassa maraṇavasena mahāpathaṁ saṁvajato mahākantāraṁ paṭipajjato mahāviduggaṁ pakkhandato pātheyyapuṭaṁ bandhati sambalaṁ sajjeti.
saddhā nāmāyaṁ sattassa maraṇavasena mahāpathaṁ saṁvajato mahākantāraṁ paṭipajjato mahāviduggaṁ pakkhandato pātheyyapuṭaṁ bandhati, sambalaṁ vissajjetīti attho.

pathe.g: idha imasmiṁ pathe mahāmagge sayameva upagatena māṇavena brāhmaṇakumārena samecca samāgantvā.
Buddhādīhi Mahesīhi sammadeva payāte samathavipassanāmagge vajantaṁ paṭipajjantaṁ.
ko pathiko pathe magge attano vassavātātaparakkhaṇatthaṁ chattaṁ gaṇhāti, chattena atthikoti attho.

Pathe.g: maggaṁ āruyha ekikāya gacchamānāyapi hi itthiyā pati nāma sulabho, diṭṭhadiṭṭhoyeva1 hoti.
pañcannaṁ sakaṭasatānaṁ purato sukhayānake nisīditvā gacchanto mahāmagge janapadamanusse addasaṁ.

Pātheyyañcā.g: bhadde mayhaṁ tava madhuravacanena bajjhitvā tīṇi saṁvaccharāni vasantasseva hatthi- assarathapattisaṅkhātaṁ balañca khīṇaṁ, manussānaṁ bhattavetanasaṅkhātaṁ pātheyyañca natthi.
